sources.name: Strength Level (current page) - Machine Calf Raise
sources.notes: Snippets for this table cite 'based on 350,435 lifts by Strength Level users since 2017' / '2017 to 2026' and '77,203 qualifying results from 350,435 community lifts'. Every row seen matches the app's raw/r4.json 'Calf Raise' rows exactly. Whole-community male: 95/181/302/453/625 lb (also the 25-40 age row); 'The average Machine Calf Raise weight for a male lifter is 302 lb' (an older snapshot said 295 lb); female average 195 lb. kg page male community: 43/82/137/205/284 kg. Strength Level has no separate standing 'Calf Raise' standards page: strengthlevel.com/strength-standards/calf-raise/lb appears in results titled 'These are the most popular Machine Calf Raise workouts...', i.e. an alias of Machine Calf Raise.

sources.name: Strength Level (older snapshot) - Machine Calf Raise
sources.ref: strengthlevel.com/strength-standards/machine-calf-raise (older cached snapshot; comparison pages e.g. machine-calf-raise-vs-seated-leg-curl/lb, -vs-sled-leg-press, -vs-smith-machine-squat; calf-raise/lb alias)
sources.notes: SUPERSEDED. Based on 348,923 lifts (fewer than the 350,435 in the current table, so older). Whole-community male 69/160/295/471/678 lb (kg 31/72/134/214/307), female 33/90/182/306/454 lb; average male 295 lb. The 110-lb row 24/81/177/310/471 was seen in a snippet for strengthlevel.com/strength-standards/calf-raise/lb and is identical to FitnessVolt's machine-calf-raise row (FitnessVolt copies this older version). The previously seen 120-lb row 32/95/198/337/504 was not re-seen in this run. A snippet gave a 180-lb row 85/177/310/480/677 for this version, but FitnessVolt's 180-lb figures (310 Int / 480 Adv / 677 Elite) are the same, so its origin is uncertain and it is not listed above. Same pattern as other Strength Level calf pages: the older version had lower Beginner and much higher Elite values.

Calf Raise.summary: The app's 'Calf Raise' rows (raw/r4.json, sourced from machine-calf-raise/lb) ARE the current Strength Level table: 21 of 21 snippet rows checked (9 male, 8 female, plus 3 earlier) match exactly, and they are tied to the larger 350,435-lift count. The 24/81/177/310/471 version is the older 348,923-lift snapshot (still on comparison pages, the calf-raise/lb alias and FitnessVolt). Strength Level has no separate standing 'Calf Raise' page; calf-raise redirects/aliases to Machine Calf Raise.

sources.name: Strength Level (current page)
sources.notes: 'Based on 140,620 lifts by Strength Level users from 2020 to 2026.' Average 434 lb men, 296 lb women. Male ratio community 1.00x BW Beginner, 2.50x Intermediate, 5.00x Elite.
